office.comment: Sergey has chosen to walk the broad path in life. He takes care of any business which is on the wrong side of law and/or ethics. With due payment, of course.
office.name: Sergey Shipping Inc.

cards.comment: The media publish a story alleging that <¤CBand.name> partied with Royalty and emptied a sixty year old bottle of brandy into the King's slippers while the virgin Princess is reported to have puked in a bucket.\n\tOther media also run this story and you smell a rat in Sergey.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Uncover Rock Scandal
cards.Caption: Rock Stars in Royal Scandal
cards.question: The scandal is great publicity

cards.comment: TV24 show scandal footage of <¤CBand.name> chaperoned by their mothers to make sure they eat, sleep and get to gigs on time.\n\tNot very Rock 'n' Rollish and you suspect that maybe Sergey's scandal attempt has backfired.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: TV24 Reveal Rock Band as Wimps
cards.question: Your band is the laughing stock of the music industry

cards.comment: You owe Sergey a favour for the loan and he demands you change the band's name to Sergey & the Spektors. Best do as he says.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: A Favour for Sergey
cards.question: Change band name to Sergey & the Spektors?

cards.comment: The practice room has been ransacked and all the instruments are scattered around the room and scrolled on the wall in red paint is: Pay up or be gunned down.\n\tThe band are scared.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Practice Room Vandalised
cards.question: Pay $10.000 to replace the destroyed equipment

cards.comment: The practice room is spattered with blood putting the frights into the band who wonder who is out to get them.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Blood Spattered Practice Room
cards.question: Pay $5000 to clean up

cards.comment: <missionvar.myknocked.name> was attacked and beaten in a surprise assault.\n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<missionvar.myknocked.gender>]} has to spend two weeks in the hospital to have {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<missionvar.myknocked.gender>, #Genitive:1]} jaw wired and nose reset.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: <missionvar.myknocked.name> Attacked
cards.question: <missionvar.myknocked.name> out for two weeks

cards.comment: <missionvar.mykilled.name> is killed in a terrible accident. As {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<missionvar.mykilled.gender>]} leaves the practice room, a huge truck squishes {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<missionvar.mykilled.gender>, #Object:1]} to a wall. Everybody panics.\n\tA brief discussion and the band decide to go on without {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<missionvar.mykilled.gender>, #Object:1]} because That is what <missionvar.mykilled.name> would have wanted.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Fatal Accident
cards.question: <missionvar.mykilled.name> killed!

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is killed in a terrible accident. As {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} leaves the practice room, a huge truck squishes {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Object:1]} to a wall.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Fatal Accident
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.name> killed!

cards.comment: The sales chart regulators discovers that somebody bought hundreds of <¤Calbum.name> in one place.\n\tThese rigged sales are disregarded, since it is obviously a case of cheating. \n  The record plummets on the sales chart.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Chart Cheat Fails
cards.question: Cheat failed

cards.comment: At practice a group of fans gathers outside autograph hunting while some have flowers and gifts for the band who are naturally touched by the generosity.\n\tEven the media show some interest in this sudden display of affection.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Arranges Fans
cards.question: The fans cheer up the band

cards.comment: A crowd of fat groupies with braces hang the practice room annoying the band.\n\tThe media show little interest in the whole thing.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Fan Fiasco
cards.question: Band bored with fans

cards.comment: With band about to go on stage the promoter announces a bomb alert and the venue is evacuated, the show cancelled.\n\tThe press make the episode headline news.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Bomb Threat at Gig
cards.Caption: Bomb Threat\nStops Concert
cards.question: Bomb threat

cards.comment: A bomb threat at the venue is ignored by the promoter and the show goes on without receiving media attention.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Bomb Threat Fails
cards.question: Bomb threat amounts to nothing

cards.comment: The gig is cancelled because of a bomb threat.\n\tThe recent threats to <¤Cband.name>'s concerts have the media speculating about mob ties and the whole thing is rather embarrassing.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Bomb Threat at Gig
cards.Caption: Rock/Mafia Connection
cards.question: Bomb threat

cards.comment: Band are arrested with supplying alcohol to minors. They might go to jail and the press have a field day.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Band Sued
cards.Caption: Artists on Trial  Drugged Minors
cards.question: Band in court

cards.comment: The band appear in court charged with forging a backstage pass.\n\tThe press seem uninterested and Sergey's plan fails miserably.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Band Sued
cards.question: The press don't give a toss

cards.comment: The band are upset that photographers follow their every move but are more upset that no photos ever make front page news, regardless what they get up to.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: No paparazzi
cards.question: No media attention

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is tragically killed in an automobile accident upsetting the band. After thinking it over they decide continue because "that is what {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} would have wanted.\n\tSergey sets up a new life for the "deceased" in a remote part of the world.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Killed in Tragic Car Wreck
cards.Caption: Passed away
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.name> killed

cards.comment: The court admonishes the band of all charges of supplying minors with alcohol and rules that there is insufficient evidence that the beverage in question was in fact alcoholic, nor that the recipients were minors.\n\tNor audience.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Ruling in the Alcohol Case
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Band freed of charges

cards.comment: The court sentences the band to pay $10.000 fine for supplying minors in the audience with alcohol.\n\tGuess who is footing the bill.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Ruling in the Alcohol Case
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Pay $10.000 fine

cards.comment: The judge refuses to hear such an insignificant case as forgery of a backstage pass.\n\tThe band is free of all charges.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Ruling in the Forgery Case
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Charges dropped

cards.comment: The judge says he never wants to see the band again and fines them $20 for forging a backstage pass.\n\tGuess who gets the bill.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Ruling in the Forgery Case
cards.question: Pay $20 fine

cards.comment: The practice room has been ransacked and all the instruments are scattered around the room and scrolled on the wall in red paint is: Sergey & the Spektors.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Practice Room Vandalised
cards.question: Pay $10.000 to replace the destroyed equipment

cards.comment: In a spiteful article City News reveal that <¤Crealmusician.name> worked as a cleaner to pay the hotel bill on a recent overseas trip.\n\tIt appears <¤Crealmusician.firstname> didn't realise the after hours TV channels are premium rate pay per view TV and the whole thing is rather embarrassing.\n   The City News staff have a laugh at your expense.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Reveal Porn Scandal
cards.Caption: Sex Scandal at Beach Resort
cards.question: Sergey's scandal backfired

cards.comment: Radio FM reveal that <¤crealmusician.name> was known as a peeping Tom in his youth and supposedly women in the neighborhood kept the blinds closed twenty-four-seven as a result of his snooping..\n\tRadio FM also explain how much they hate perverts and <¤Crealmusician.firstname> is too embarrassed to speak.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Radio FM Uncover Peeping Tom
cards.question: Sergey's scandal backfired

cards.comment: City News reveal that <¤crealmusician.name> was recently arrested for stealing Pop-Tarts in a convenience store.\n\tThe article makes fun of a rock star like <¤Crealmusician.firstname> shoplifting and the PTA are furious.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Hunt Shoplifters
cards.Caption: \nCaught Redhanded
cards.question: Sergey's scandal backfired

cards.comment: TV24 show shocking film of <¤Cband.name> outside an elementary school bullying the kids, stealing their books, pushing them about, teasing them and letting the air out of their bicycle tyres.\n\tAfter the report follows a debate on the devastating influence of popular music on the young generation.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: TV24 Reveal Child Abuse
cards.question: Sergey's scandal misfired

cards.comment: A City News reporter team tries to take <¤crealmusician.name>'s picture as {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} leaves nightclub Avenue with a groupie on {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Genitive:1]} arm (name undisclosed), when <¤Crealmusician.firstname> goes berserk and assaults the photographer destroying the camera. The Letters to the Editor-section is certain to have plenty of material the coming few weeks.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Uncover Rock Scandal
cards.Caption: Rock Star Assaults Photographer
cards.question: The scandal is great publicity

cards.comment: City News spend better part of today's paper describing how <¤Cband.name> stumbled upon a label credit card and used it to fill a hotel bath tub with expensive Beluga caviar.\n\tIn the party that followed, somebody vomited in the caviar so they simply flushed it all down the drain.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Uncover Rock Scandal
cards.Caption: ROCK 'N' ROLL SCANDAL
cards.question: The scandal is great publicity

cards.comment: City News run the story of <¤crealmusician.name> being drunk on a recent flight, harassing cabin crew and fighting the captain.\n  <¤Crealmusician.firstname> ended the flight hand-cuffed in the plane's hold and City News make it big news.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Uncover Rock Scandal
cards.Caption: Rock Star Assaults Cabin Crew
cards.question: The scandal is great publicity

cards.comment: Photographers line up as paramedics roll out supermodel Kim la Trine from <¤Cband.name>'s practice room on a stretcher after a wild night.\n\tThe model is conscious and unharmed but too exhausted to stand up and is taken to hospital for observation.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Uncover Rock Scandal
cards.Caption: ROCK SCANDAL Model hospitalised
cards.question: The scandal is great publicity

cards.comment: The papers are brimming with pictures of the band in the Jacuzzi with famous movie twins Tina & Tuna.\n\tLots of flesh to scandalize. You sense a touch of Sergey's hand in this.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Paparazzi
cards.Caption: Swimsuit Issue
cards.question: The band are all over the press (in swimsuits)

cards.comment: City News print photos of a hot rendez-vous between <¤crealmusician.name> and super model Kim la Trine on the top of a remote rock where they thought they were safe from spying cameras.\n\tThe pictures, however, are very detailed and get a lot of room in the magazine.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Paparazzi
cards.Caption: Mountain Top Lovin'
cards.question: Sergey's paparazzi did well
